scope: Official public documentation reviewed for documented capabilities, not a live product trial or proof of absent features.

sources.claim_reference: Version and security update PRs, manifest-based version checks.
sources.limitation: Configuration and ecosystem support vary; no unattended product trial.

sources.claim_reference: Configurable grouping, update types, dependency criteria and monorepo grouping.
sources.limitation: Configured behavior, not evidence every installation uses it.

sources.claim_reference: Manifest, lockfile and submitted dependency snapshots support repository dependency views.
sources.limitation: Supported ecosystems and submitted data determine coverage; not a release-boundary forensic claim.

sources.document: Reviewing dependency changes in a pull request
sources.claim_reference: Added, removed and updated dependencies with release dates and vulnerability information in PR review.
sources.limitation: Docs warn that unparsed dependency changes may not appear.

sources.claim_reference: Organization dependency insights show usage, vulnerabilities and licenses.
sources.limitation: Enterprise Cloud feature in maintenance mode; may be incomplete with dependency submission; private dependencies excluded.

sources.claim_reference: Per-run logs include job and step status.
sources.limitation: Repository access and retention govern historical availability; CI outcome is not ecosystem recovery.

sources.document: REST API endpoints for pull requests
sources.claim_reference: PR, review, commit and changed-file endpoints expose repository evidence.
sources.limitation: API access is a data source, not an assembled release-forensics workflow.

sources.claim_reference: Renovate scans references and can create updates; editions include CLI, hosted and repository integrations.
sources.limitation: Capabilities differ by edition; do not attribute Remediate to every Renovate deployment.

sources.claim_reference: Repository dashboard issue shows pending, closed and ignored updates and can gate PR creation.
sources.limitation: A repository update dashboard is not a release-bounded downstream cohort report.

sources.claim_reference: fetchChangeLogs controls release-note/changelog retrieval for PRs.
sources.limitation: Fetched upstream text is not downstream-local evidence.

sources.claim_reference: Remediate can create fix PRs and include available changelogs/commit history.
sources.limitation: Page explicitly describes Classic Repository Integrations and legacy screenshots.

sources.claim_reference: Risk factors combine reachability, exploitability and maliciousness statuses in dependency views.
sources.limitation: Security-risk prioritization is not a general post-release compatibility timeline.

sources.claim_reference: Manifest scan builds direct/transitive tree and queries vulnerability database.
sources.limitation: Some project types require build/install for a complete tree.

sources.claim_reference: SCM integrations can run PR checks and open fix/upgrade PRs; CI integrations enforce policy gates.
sources.limitation: Overview does not establish every feature for every ecosystem, edition or repository.

sources.claim_reference: GetVersion and GetDependencies expose package-version metadata and generic resolved graphs.
sources.limitation: Generic graph may differ from a repository's environment or historic resolved state.

sources.claim_reference: Project/release routes expose metadata, versions and distribution files.
sources.limitation: Upload metadata may not match file contents; registry data does not prove downstream usage.

sources.claim_reference: GitHub app checks dependency changes and comments on supply-chain risk.
sources.limitation: Security-focused PR check; configuration and ecosystem support vary.

sources.claim_reference: Organization scan view lists repositories, branches, PRs, commits, dependencies and alerts.
sources.limitation: Strong overlap in multi-repo evidence views, but docs describe risk scans rather than a target-release forensic case.

sources.claim_reference: Dashboard aggregates component risk and violations across applications; reports export.
sources.limitation: Documented cross-application capability materially narrows any PULSE multi-repo novelty claim.

sources.document: Policy Evaluation in Source Control Management
sources.claim_reference: SCM integration can comment on policy violations and open remediation PRs.
sources.limitation: Policy/security-remediation focus; configuration-dependent.

sources.claim_reference: Component match states include Exact, Similar and Unknown with identification source.
sources.limitation: Unknown component identity is different from PULSE's unknown post-release outcome.

sources.document: View the overall state of your Organization
sources.claim_reference: Organization dashboard aggregates application/project scans, findings and remediation statuses over time.
sources.limitation: Security findings/remediations, not a general named-release compatibility cohort.
